data_quality.notes: Gold review: Aer Lingus fees split sharply between Europe and transatlantic service: small personal item is universal, 10 kg carry-on access is entitlement/add-on based, checked-bag prices vary by route, season, and timing, and overweight is per-kg in Europe but per-bag transatlantic. Aer Lingus Regional now follows the 10 kg carry-on model, with smaller-aircraft limits.

data_quality.notes: Aer Lingus separates the under-seat personal item from the 10 kg bag; Saver travelers can usually check the 10 kg bag free instead of bringing it onboard.

fees.conditions: 10 kg bag onboard is paid or included; Saver gate presentation without entitlement triggers a hold fee

data_quality.notes: Aer Lingus extended the 10 kg carry-on policy to Aer Lingus Regional from March 3, 2026, but Regional flights use smaller/7 kg aircraft limits.
